Fixed `last()` in [more_itertools/more.py](file:///work/more_itertools/more.py#L286) so that iterables with `__reversed__ = None` (or a non-callable `__reversed__`) are not treated as reversible.

### Change
- Updated [last](file:///work/more_itertools/more.py#L270-L295) to check `callable(getattr(iterable, '__reversed__', None))` instead of `hasattr(iterable, '__reversed__')`, allowing `last()` to fall back to `deque(iterable, maxlen=1)[-1]` when `__reversed__` is `None`.

### Verification
- Ran `./venv/bin/python -m pytest -vv tests/test_more.py`: `544 passed, 8 warnings, 2251 subtests passed`, including `LastTests::test_reversed_is_none`.
